mobbin:0a0113c1-6c8a-4764-a2b7-938abacee.summary: User works through Getting Started checklists and opens Home. They land on a Welcome home with recents, My tasks, empty Suggested and Trending, templates, and Learn cards.
steps: Team Getting Started invite and teamspaces checklist
Home tip on the sidebar Home item
Welcome home with recents, My tasks, and Suggested
Home with empty Suggested and Trending copy
Personalised greeting and tasks with statuses
Home with Featured templates and Learn
steal: First-run is a live checklist page in the workspace (invite teammates, add teamspaces) rather than a pop-up-only tour (screens 1-2).
Recently visited cards jump back into work already started (screens 4-8).
Empty Suggested and Trending copy ('Pages relevant to you will show up here') replaces blank panels (screens 5-6).
My tasks rows show due date, status label (In progress / Not started), and source tag as a scannable what-needs-me list (screens 7-8).
avoid: No widget add, remove, or reorder controls appear. Tagging this as widgets overstates customisation; the home is a fixed stack of sections.
mobbin:0a0113c1-6c8a-4764-a2b7-938abacee.fit: Dashboard: recents and My tasks replace tile sprawl. Tasks hand off to Debrief or Courses for grading and to Scheduling for due sessions. Featured templates and Learn map to first-run for a new center, not a Reports wall.

mobbin:cb1f904a-8674-4b22-8793-bd431804a.summary: From a Welcome checklist the user reaches Home with ask or search, Upcoming events for today and tomorrow, and a My tasks list where one task is checked complete.
steps: Home with ask bar, recents, Upcoming events, and My tasks
Home focused on Upcoming events and tasks with one done
steal: Upcoming events are grouped by day ('Today July 11', next day) above the task list, so the agenda needs no full calendar module.
My tasks shows a checkbox complete state (Landing page checked) with due dates and project tag still visible (screen 3).
Home combines recents, agenda, and tasks in one scroll, and New task sits on the list itself (screen 2).
mobbin:cb1f904a-8674-4b22-8793-bd431804a.fit: Dashboard: Today strip fed by Scheduling (sessions by time and room) with task checkboxes for faculty action items that open Debrief or Courses. It lives on the dashboard, not a separate calendar page.

mobbin:2abedcd0-4648-4c73-be51-6dd1763ed.summary: A private workspace shows a Welcome checklist and full sidebar (Recents, Agents, Teamspaces, Notion Apps), then a trial unlock pop-up over the same page, then the page alone again.
steps: Welcome checklist with full sidebar modules
Trial unlock pop-up over the Welcome page
Welcome checklist after the pop-up is closed
steal: The sidebar exposes Home, Search, Inbox, Recents, companion apps (Mail/Calendar), My Tasks, and New page or chat as module nav and quick-create in one rail.
A trial '30 days left' badge in the nav adds time-boxed setup urgency (screen 1).
A trial checklist pop-up with a locked reward step is an optional layer on top of the in-page guide (screen 2).
avoid: A gamified 'unlock a rare accessory' trial pop-up is noise for a clinical ops dashboard (screen 2).
mobbin:2abedcd0-4648-4c73-be51-6dd1763ed.fit: Dashboard: sidebar pattern for Essentials module navigation (Recording, Scheduling, Reports, and so on) plus a dashboard-only Welcome checklist. Companion-app links resemble handoffs to Calendar or Scheduling rather than widgets.
